scientific_origin.interpretation: new bird test evaluates a different moderator/topology-specific hypothesis and cannot alter the historical beetle primary status

mechanism_prediction.possible_source_set: the six frozen pilot islands only for every confirmatory prediction
mechanism_prediction.weight_definition: w_ij = exp(-actual_graph_shortest_path_km(i,j)/lambda), lambda fixed to the v1.01 actual-graph kernel scale
mechanism_prediction.configuration_sensitivity: S_i(n) = ((M-n)/(n*(M-1))) * (sigma_i^2 / mu_i^2), computed across the M fixed possible-source weights for target i
mechanism_prediction.n_definition: number of the six pilot islands occupied by bird species s, learned only from the one-shot pilot response
mechanism_prediction.n_zero_rule: species with n=0 have no occupied source and are ineligible
mechanism_prediction.n_six_rule: species with n=6 have S_i(n)=0 and no sparse-source configuration contrast; exclude from the primary mechanism species universe
mechanism_prediction.claim: higher S_i(n) should predict a more negative actual-topology minus matched-null presence log-loss contrast

pilot_gate.species_eligibility: after one-shot pilot access, retain bird species with 1 to 5 occupied pilot islands; confirmatory response may not define eligibility
pilot_gate.if_failed: STOP bird route before confirmatory response; do not widen n or lower thresholds

null_topology_requirement.edge_length_structure: exact counts preserved across five response-independent actual-edge quintile bins
null_topology_requirement.kernel_scale: use the same actual-graph lambda for every null

model_rule_after_clean_pilot.fit: deterministic pooled ridge logistic regression, lambda=1, same numerical rule as the completed boreal beetle pipeline
R3_add: pilot-only log1p nearest Euclidean occupied-source distance
actual_C_add: pilot-only log1p nearest actual-graph occupied-source distance
model_rule_after_clean_pilot.null_C_add: the same two graph-path source features recomputed separately for each of the 20 frozen null topologies

primary_scoring.cell_contrast: D_is = logloss(actual_C, y=1) - mean_k logloss(null_C_k, y=1); negative favours actual topology
primary_scoring.moderator: z-score of log1p(S_i(n_s)) over the complete eligible confirmatory prediction surface, frozen before confirmatory response
primary_scoring.within_block_statistic: OLS slope of D_is on moderator among presence cells in a confirmatory spatial block
primary_scoring.block_estimability: at least 3 presence cells and positive moderator variance
primary_scoring.primary_estimand: equal-weight mean of estimable block slopes
primary_scoring.uncertainty: deterministic 10000-replicate bootstrap over estimable confirmatory spatial blocks
primary_scoring.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and 95% bootstrap upper bound < 0
primary_scoring.nonestimable_rule: if fewer than four blocks are estimable, report non-estimable; do not replace the endpoint with all cells

secondary_nonrescuing: actual topology rank among the 20 nulls
next_action: freeze and commit the response-independent 20-null topology ensemble and target-by-n S_i(n) surface before any bird matrix semantic access
